title: The Carrington Event: When the Sun Set Telegraphs on Fire (1859)
description:
In September 1859, astronomer Richard Carrington saw the first solar flare ever recorded. About seventeen and a half hours later, the biggest magnetic storm on record hit Earth: auroras over the Caribbean, sparking telegraphs, and operators sending messages with their batteries unplugged. Here's the full story, and why scientists still watch the Sun for the next one.
